scope: Gate1 source audit and Gate2 DB mapping only; no consumer implementation or production cutover
canonicalBindingPolicy: Every source-derived consumer references exactly one selector. The selector enumerates its planned target tables and field-map columns; tests close every PK/FK and referenced PK against the authoritative schema. Undeclared selectors, registry/source mismatches, orphan consumers and duplicate primary slices are forbidden.

globalRules.identity: Kakao external_user_id is resolved through an exact persisted crosswalk to canonical_players.player_id CHAR(8); display_name inference is forbidden
globalRules.reference: all object references use the referenced table's typed PK and never a generic id or generic CODE
globalRules.definitionOwnership: definition values remain in definition tables; ownership tables store only typed references, quantity and per-occurrence mutable state
globalRules.auditClock: INSERT_TIME and UPDATE_TIME use KST YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS at the database boundary
globalRules.mutation: lock canonical owner then affected balances/instances in stable PK order; validate; write domain ledger/replay and outbox in one transaction; rollback all on failure
globalRules.replay: actor/player plus request_key and payload fingerprint; exact replay returns the prior result with zero writes and drift fails closed
globalRules.environment: PROD and DEV resolve to different configured database identities; no table may mix the partitions
globalRules.dispatch: one event has exactly one writer; MODERN and LEGACY_FALLBACK are mutually exclusive

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: PlayerContextPort resolves provider+external_user_id to exactly one BIGINT legacy actor and one CHAR(8) canonical player; RequestContextPort carries environment, actor, request_key and payload fingerprint.
slices.transaction: identity resolution is read-only; each downstream mutation owns one transaction including its outbox
slices.rollback: no crosswalk is synthesized on a consumer read; unresolved or ambiguous identity aborts before writes
slices.replay: object_identity_operations is required for mutating identity/crosswalk commands; downstream request key is namespaced by environment and actor
slices.outbox: outbox actor and destination are taken from resolved context, never display name
slices.environmentPartition: database identity plus explicit PROD/DEV context

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: consolidate current inventory services behind CanonicalItemInventoryPort; forbid name-keyed bag writes.
slices.transaction: all item deltas, ledger/replay receipt and outbox commit together
slices.rollback: any capacity, quantity or definition failure rolls back every delta
slices.replay: canonical_item_inventory_operations player_id+request_key with payload drift rejection
slices.outbox: success reply only after committed operation

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: CanonicalCurrencyPort is mandatory for every shop/draw/reward path and composes with ItemPort in one outer transaction.
slices.transaction: currency and item deltas share one transaction
slices.rollback: insufficient balance or reward failure restores both domains

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: every active combine is catalog recipe lookup; missing legacy furniture-combine trigger is recorded as absent, not invented.
slices.transaction: confirmation, input consumption, outputs, craft ledger and outbox are atomic
slices.rollback: any input/output/confirmation drift aborts all writes

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: draw policy resolves sealed source rate to furniture_id; rate must never populate charm_per_enhancement.
slices.transaction: ownership state, placement/listing, ledger/replay and outbox are atomic
slices.rollback: capacity, active listing or draw-policy mismatch aborts

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: HomeAggregateReadPort derives values from canonical definitions plus owned state; no denormalized charm copy becomes authoritative.
lockOrder: read-only stable player_id then owned PK order
slices.transaction: read-only snapshot transaction where rank consistency requires it
slices.rollback: not applicable; read fails closed on missing reference
slices.replay: reads have no domain receipt; aggregate/rank mutations require canonical_home_aggregate_operations
slices.outbox: rank reply may be outboxed without mutating aggregate state

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: CanonicalPetCorePort fills lifecycle/read gaps; existing equipment/pendant services must use it rather than legacy name lookup.
slices.transaction: pet/equipment ownership and market effects are atomic
slices.rollback: cross-owner, slot or definition mismatch aborts

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: all consumers address owned_mini_pet_id occurrence; same definition may be owned N times.
slices.transaction: instance state, cost/reward ledger, replay and outbox are atomic
slices.rollback: cross-owner, stale level or capacity mismatch aborts

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: selection references an owned occurrence and definition prices remain catalog-only.
slices.replay: canonical_member_title_operations is required for definition, ownership and selection mutations

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: explicit player-scope selection limitation; current schema does not bind selection to owned_pet_id.
slices.transaction: ownership/selection/admin sync and outbox are atomic
slices.rollback: unowned selection or sync drift aborts
slices.replay: canonical_pet_title_operations is required for definition, ownership, selection and sync mutations

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: explicit player-scope selection limitation; current schema does not bind selection to owned_mini_pet_id.
slices.transaction: collection qualification, title grant/selection and outbox are atomic
slices.replay: canonical_mini_pet_title_operations is required for collection, ownership and selection mutations

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: handler_key/options are catalog data, executable behavior remains allowlisted code; equipment requires stack quantity greater than zero.
slices.rollback: unknown handler, missing stock or cross-owner pet aborts

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: typed MarketOrchestrator coordinates domain ownership ports and CurrencyPort; it never stores a generic object CODE.
lockOrder: both seller and buyer canonical_players.player_id in ascending binary PK order
currency balances in ascending player_id then currency_id order
slices.transaction: reserve, fee, currency, ownership transfer, settlement, replay and outbox share one transaction
slices.rollback: any cross-domain failure restores listing, asset and balances
slices.replay: canonical_market_operations plus canonical_market_transfer_ledger_entries store request fingerprint and prior settlement result

slices.portPlan: EXISTING_PLUS_ADDITIVE: graph writes validate typed targets and cycles; unknown targets quarantine fail-closed.

slices.rollback: cycle, unknown target or graph drift aborts

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: PackageUseOrchestrator consumes package and fans out through typed domain ports under one outer transaction.

slices.rollback: any reward failure restores package and every reward
slices.replay: canonical_package_use_operations plus canonical_package_use_reward_ledger_entries store request_key, package graph and quantity fingerprint

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: CanonicalOwnerGraphPort enumerates every typed ownership table for cleanup/delete; partial graph mutation is forbidden.
lockOrder: ownership tables in fixed contract order
slices.transaction: admin authorization, owner graph mutation, audit/replay and outbox are atomic
slices.rollback: missing table coverage or row-count drift aborts
slices.replay: canonical_admin_lifecycle_operations stores admin actor+target player+request_key+payload fingerprint
slices.outbox: admin and affected-user results after commit
slices.environmentPartition: explicit environment; cross-environment admin operation forbidden

slices.portPlan: ADDITIVE_REQUIRED: ConsumerTransitionDispatcher is the sole writer selector for Iris, scheduler, admin and web entry points.
lockOrder: dispatch decision before domain transaction; no second writer lock path
slices.transaction: selected handler owns exactly one domain transaction
slices.rollback: handler failure never falls through to the other writer
slices.replay: canonical_app_wiring_operations returns the prior route/result for duplicate event/request with zero domain writes
